backend_tests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_telemetry.py tests/test_telemetry_retained.py tests/test_telemetry_control.py tests/test_telemetry_migrations.py tests/test_decision_references.py tests/test_gpt_level_timing.py tests/test_decision_sources.py tests/test_decision_hourly.py tests/test_decision_evidence.py tests/test_hourly_brief.py tests/test_training.py -q

contract.authority: telemetry_readings, every unique collector batch at nominal 5-second cadence
contract.new_decisions: versioned references to telemetry and append-only manual measurements; decision-time interpretations and outputs frozen inline
contract.legacy: Existing inline decisions and compressed archives remain readable and unchanged; sparse historical sampling is not filled in
contract.lag: Use latest raw history at or before prediction minus 90 seconds, within 30 seconds; never use decision archive or latest cache as substitute raw history
contract.retention: Unreferenced telemetry follows configured retention; decision_telemetry_pins keeps referenced readings even after hot decisions move to compressed archives
contract.missing_references: Explicit failure; never substitute current values or recompute old predictions
contract.manual_defaults: Mutable legacy input settings and transformed/computed values remain frozen decision evidence

deployment.compatibility: Unversioned existing site uses its existing create_all/schema_upgrade deployment path. Direct Alembic upgrade encountered an existing alerts table; no existing table was rebuilt. New/previously versioned database migrations verified separately.
